name: Segmented
summary: Switch between a few mutually-exclusive options inline.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-segmented> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; selection slides a persistent thumb (transform on a node that is never rebuilt), so it animates. Zero drift — the same element, not two look-alikes.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

whenToUse.when: 2–4 short, mutually-exclusive views or modes that switch in place
one option from a longer list that needn't be all visible

opinion.note: Keep labels to one word where possible and the option count small (2–4). It is a single-select control — for a magnitude use Rate or a Slider.
opinion.dsv3: Track gray-20, thumb bg-container white with a soft shadow, selected label text-default. The thumb is a persistent node moved by transform via the shared motion tokens — no subtree rebuild on select.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step. The fast path for vibe-coding.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render. The probe holds value=Week so a selected segment exists.
